text: In 1974, four children playing hide-and-seek in an abandoned convent [scare ten-year-old Robin until she falls through a window|wrong|an accident and its guilt], and they swear never to tell. Six years later, on the night of the school prom and the anniversary of her death, the four receive anonymous phone calls and find their [yearbook photos stabbed with glass|images|pictures, screens and recordings]. During the dance, a figure in a ski mask [comes for each of them in turn|wants|revenge for a wrong], while Robin's sister Kim waits to be crowned queen.
